name: IL Siracusano
desc:
The invitation is unexpected, but she knew it would come some day.
The explosion is premeditated, but he was well aware it would happen eventually.
The gunshot resounds through the clouds, and he has waited several decades for it.
The farewell is long overdue, and she turns away with no intention to stay.
The city is in its rainy season, so don't forget to bring an umbrella.

infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Texas wakes up from a dream, knowing that her past has come knocking on her door. Dark clouds loom over Volsinii; the rainy season has come.
Sora arrives at the theater she is to work at next. Leontuzzo finds Texas and informs her about her next assignment.
Sora meets a strange audience member while rehearsing the play. The city of Volsinii grows more and more restless as a banquet between Families is about to be held.
Lappland catches up to Texas. After an explosion, each party is forced to make their decision.
Given his current situation, Leontuzzo decides to grit his teeth and wait things out. Texas is interrogated. Lappland receives a call from her father, but has plans of her own.
While Texas sits in prison, various forces on the outside begin to clash, and a plot to assassinate Lavinia takes shape.

Lavinia is deeply affected by the death of her former colleague-turned-hitman. Leontuzzo tries to persuade Lavinia to drop her investigation, and just as the two reach an impasse, Texas volunteers to stand trial as the murderer.
A new round of games starts among the Famiglie, revolving around Texas's identity.
A truck plows into the courtroom, putting a halt to Texas's trial.
Lappland goes to jail in Texas's place. Leontuzzo sees the Signore dei Lupi, and Sora realizes that the member of the audience she spoke with was the author of 'La Morte di Texas.'
Wallach is infuriated at Texas's decision. Lavinia proposes a meeting with Bernardo, intending to question him about his decision.
The heads of the two famiglie decide to join forces. For the first time during her years in Siracusa, Texas scores a kill that she deems worthwhile. Lavinia is unable to find the answer she seeks.
The stage has been set, and the fun is about to begin.
All roads have been paved. She has uncovered her past.
The audience has scattered in every direction, and the battle between assassins has shifted elsewhere. Everyone reminisces about the past.

Il Segretario di Sicurezza Alimentare recommends himself for the role of Ministro dei Lavori Pubblici. The Penguin Logistics employees finally meet in Siracusa, but there are more pressing matters for them to resolve.
The show has come to an end. Some stand closer together, others drift apart.
Giovanna collapses to the ground after an attack. Il Segretario di Sicurezza Alimentare asks Lavinia for help, and Exusiai seeks out Agenir to ask a question that has plagued her for a long time.
On a clear morning, the crisp clarion call of a pistol's muzzle reverberates across Volsinii through every radio.
Texas finally feels anger at everything unfolding in front of her. Leontuzzo finally comes to understand his father's ultimate purpose, and decides his own path.
The separation of the secondary core area is imminent. The last generation pins its hopes on the next one.
Texas once rejected everything, but now she chooses to stand firm. There is no place for Lappland in Siracusa, and she doesn't need one anyway.
Seeing the youths in front of her puts a smile on Signora Sicilia's face.
The clash between civilization and savagery never ends.
